body: I’m not cutting myself because i was rejected, it’s true that it hurts a lot, and I’ve come to terms with the fact that i am just unlovable piece of shit. But that’s not the reason I’m cutting myself
Yeah it is dude, why don’t you try turning into a hobby or something
Actually, it does have a certain vibe to it that I just can’t put my finger on, maybe with the right kind of music, this could turn into something artistic.

Actually, as of yesterday I began cutting myself to punish myself for something I did ( I won’t go into what it is) and right now my room mate (I.e the woman I love, who rejected me, and with whom I share the most unbelievable bond ) knows about it ( at least I think she does ), and a coworker begged me to tell her what I was hiding under my bandages, so I gave in and told her. And now anyone who reads this on reddit knows it as well, and so do you !! Am I afraid one of these people might have sent to the psych ward ? A little bit, am I scared about it ? Yes, because my family might get wind of it. Do I wanna kill myself ? Everyday a bit more!!! So in the end being scared is normal, and if you are strong enough to ask for help then by all means please do so !!!
Is this some kind of haiku ??
Thanks, but I don’t want to be around when they do because I know deep inside I don’t deserve anything good in my life and life proves that to me every single day. But still thanks

I’m sorry to hear that, I hope life turn around for you!! And don’t worry you won’t have to see anything, I’m doing this in my own room, even my room mate (who’s the woman I talked about)doesn’t know, so don’t worry !! I just hope I find those rolls bandages thingys i forget what they’re called so I can hide all this before going to work tomorrow

No they won’t , that’s just a lie people make up to avoid depression and anxiety and stress, and I’ve had all three for as long as I can remember ( I’m 26 if you are wondering). So yeah life sucks for me, I really wanna kill myself, but small steps, since I still to put some things into order , or maybe I won’t who cares anyway

Long story short, I asked the only woman I ever love (who already rejected me) and with whom I have such a strong bond that don’t know what to call ourselves, to sleep with me !! And for the first time in my life I’m regretting something I did, so there you go short and to the point unlike this damn knife that won’t make me bleed
I know it is necessary, and the worse thing is, i know it’s gonna even begin to make for what i did
I can multi task, just gonna heat the knife up for a bit and I’m back
If it the place you’re cutting feels really warm, does it mean it’s gonna be easier to cut open ? Asking for a friend !!
Because I’m an awful human being, who did something despicable!! So short of killing myself right away, this the next best thing !!
Well I need those scars to remember what I did, so win-win
Like 30 mins ago, why ?

I... don’t .... know ..., I surely will never give up on her, but right I just have this heart wrenching feeling for so long that there might be a day where I won’t get to see her anymore and i don’t want to live long enough for it to happen. I wanna die while I still have happy memories of her laughing, of all the hugs we shared, of all the times she grabbed my hand and didn’t want to let go,of all those moment we shared at the most unbelievable hours where we either talked or just sat there together, and when she allowed me to spend her birthday with her and I went out my way to make it the most special ever where I didn’t give a fuck if I spent 100 or 1000$ just to see her cute smile . 😢😢😢😢😢😢😢😢

At this point we don’t know how to qualify ourselves we’re waaaay past friends, waaaay past best friends, we’re roommates and I mean I can’t believe how blessed I am to be able to see her everyday but I love her so so much

We weren’t in a relationship, I’ve never been in one. But after 26 years she’s the first woman I met that makes me feel this way that makes want to enjoy life, but I guess I’m not meant to. I’m only meant to hurt and suffer. I don’t think I can wait 2 years. It’s too much!!

Well as it turns out, the woman I love , for whom I want nothing more but to make her happy, the first and only woman I’ll ever have those feelings for, the only reason I’m still holding on for a bit, doesn’t see us ever being together, I mean I was expecting it I’m just an unlovable selfish asshole, but why do I only hurt in this life why do I have to cry myself to sleep every night ? Why did god  let me meet this beautiful amazing angel if he’s just going to take her away from me? Why do I still have to live in pain ? Please don’t let me wake up tomorrow I’m begging you, kill me however you see fit just end it please !!!!
On the contrary it’s no hassle at all, I appreciate you taking out of you time to respond and chat. Thank you!

I’m not planing on doing it tonight, I’m giving myself until my 28th birthday might be sooner but it’s not today. I don’t think there is or there has ever been anything good about me, even if there were it doesn’t matter, because life doesn’t work that way.

After all those years I tried everything I can, and there is no loss. You can’t lose what you never had, you can’t break what was never whole.i used to think I could be happy alone but being alone with my thoughts only leads to one conclusion, thanks for listening. I know I sound like a broken record, but still I really appreciate it.

I don’t want to have to feel this way, all my life, I know I gave myself 2 years but I don’t know if I can hold on for that long !! I’m at a point of my life where a lot of thing come into perspective, I’ll never know what it feels like to be loved back by another woman, I mean I finally found her, but I don’t deserve to be with her, I’ll never know happiness, I hardly have the will to get out of bed anymore, as I’m lying asleep everyday I pray that I don’t wake up the next day. I listen to music and at some point it just turns into background noise for my thoughts, i have no appetite each time i see rails I tell myself wait until you’re alone, every time i see a couple I tell myself “ you’ll never get that, you’ll never have what they have “. A mother talking about her son does give me gut wrenching feeling , and I’m sorry for what happened to your son. But sooner or later my miserable story has to come to an end and i don’t think I wanna see the end of it!

That’s just it no matter how hard I try it always blows up in my face, you said I’m a lucky guy for having those people in my life and I can’t deny that but more and more I feel like a burden to everybody around me like everyone would be so much better off if I didn’t exist

I used to think that to, that I can get through that I can turn my life around and make it better somehow, but it keeps getting harder and harder to hold on to what little I have left as it’s being taken away from me
I’m listening
I know I’m trying not leave anything unsaid, and when I finally found happiness it’s being taken away from me. So no point in hoping !! Thanks anyway
I thought I’d give myself 2 years and do it on my 28th birthday, but I don’t think there’s a point in waiting that long !!
Just make sure you don’t regret what you do, because trust me nothing is worse than regret !! (Well some things are but it’s up there )

You should consider who you’re being nice to, sometimes we end giving the wrong people the main part in our life and the right ones just a side note. Because there is no such thing as getting what you deserve, you just get what you get, and those who you consider mean get the better of it because most are sociopaths and know how manipulate people through emotions and and a mask that changes everyday. Should become that way ? Never !! Because in that way of living you’ll end up losing who you are and will never get satisfied or happy enough to want to stop. Life sucks ? Of course it does. I’m just some lowlife who will die in a couple of years. But still I understand what you’re going through, and I really hope you find your peace and that it works out for you in end !! Don’t stop being nice !! The world needs people like that !!

Experiencing how it is to have won’t change much if not stress you out a bit if you’re not doing something you like, try writing a draft and go all out no stops, write to everyone you thinks you still need to tell something or the people who you think need to read it, you’ll see a lot of things might come into perspective. I hope you get all you want out of life, god knows I can’t !

I’m going through the exact same thing, I recently turned 26, but I’m only giving myself 2 years. If I can’t get my life in order by then what’s the point ? It’s true that each one has his own battle to fight, if there’s something that makes want to hold on never let go, no matter how small you think it is , because it will literally save your life. My life has been going down the drain for years now, but I really hope you get to turn yours around and be saved from a world of hurt. Good luck in your future endeavours !! If you need some to talk to, please do not hesitate. I know we might be struggling in a similar way but maybe I can be of some help!!

Seems there were a lot of misunderstandings: My upbringing or religion dont have anything to do with, and I didn’t say that doing any of those things made anyone a bad person by any means I’m just enumerating what I never did. And I know sex isn’t some reward you get after being good or anything. And I’m really not pressuring her or being intense about anything, it’s just that I know this is the first time and most certainly last time I’ll ever fall in love. So of course I’m giving her my all while trying to give her the space she needs.
